# Dealer Agent Gateway

Dealer Agent Gateway is the open reference implementation of Dealer Agent Protocol. It exposes a read-only MCP surface for dealer-published vehicle inventory, authoritative availability, advertised pricing, required dealer charges, discounts, rebates, and incentives.

The public reference contains synthetic data only. It is a conformance and interoperability fixture, not a production dealer integration. It does not expose DMS or CRM access, customer records, leads, appointments, desking, credit, payments, contracts, service, or parts.

## Canonical resources

- Website: https://dealeragentgateway.com/
- Streamable HTTP endpoint: https://mcp.dealeragentgateway.com/mcp
- Protocol: https://dealeragentprotocol.com/
- MCP Registry metadata: https://dealeragentprotocol.com/server.json
- Source: https://github.com/arielcoro/dealer-agent-protocol
- License: Apache-2.0
